content.text:
I built the vote-by-mail flyer in scene s197cd3d5cd and rendered all three sizes (portrait, wide and sky). The layout check reported no defects. I adjusted the sizes only through constraints, with no per-size edits.

- **Layout:** the photo band, red "VOTE BY MAIL" bar and headline stretch to full width at every size. The photo crops to fill its band instead of distorting.
- **Candidates:** Dana Levi (Mayor), Omar Haddad (Council) and Ruth Cohen (Council) stay evenly spaced across the width at each size.
- **Sky size:** because it's scaled down to 0.28, the footer text is only about 7px there, and the step and candidate text are also very small. The headline comes out at 21px.

Files are in `/var/folders/hf/35wnqrnj2bbb1_llbg87zlt40000gn/T/scene-mcp-e2e-llm-83014/renders/s197cd3d5cd/`:
